pr.body:
Closes #3039

## Problem

`MergeOp::next` pulled one input batch, ran the match sub-plan for it, created or updated its rows, and only then pulled the next batch. A row in a later batch therefore saw an earlier batch's creations, after their `ON CREATE SET`. A row in the same batch did not; only the created-pattern cache stood in for those. The result depended on where the 1024-row boundaries fell:

```
UNWIND range(1,N) AS x WITH x WHERE x = 1 OR x = N
MERGE (n:L {v: CASE x WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END}) ON CREATE SET n.v = 2
Rust main: N=2 -> 2 nodes, N=1025 -> 1 node        C: 2 and 2
```

## Fix

Do what C's `op_merge.c` does: consume the whole input and match every row before anything is created. The new `MergeOp::match_all` pulls all input batches on the first `next()` and runs one match sub-plan per input batch, so matching stays batched. Creating, `ON MATCH`/`ON CREATE SET` and emitting then proceed over the matched rows in input order, as before. Duplicates within the input are still resolved by the created-pattern cache.

Most of the diff is re-indentation. `git diff -w` is +81/-52, most of it the code moving into `match_all`.

Memory: the operator now holds every input row and its matches until it has emitted them. Before, it held one batch at a time. C holds all input records in the same way (`input_records`, `output_records`).

## Tests

- New flow test `test_graph_merge:testGraphMergeFlow.test41_merge_result_does_not_depend_on_batch_boundaries` uses N = 2, 1025 and 3000, plus duplicates across batches (3000 rows onto 7 nodes). Expected values checked against the C module.
  - Before (`main` @ 2363723ac): FAIL, `1.0 == 2`.
  - After, all with RLTest/pytest on private ports: `test_graph_merge` 39/39, `test_call_subquery` 54/54, `test_constraint` 26/26, `test_foreach` 19/19, `test_effects_opcodes` 12/12, `test_access_del_entity` 18/18, and `tests/test_e2e.py` + `tests/test_mvcc.py` 94/94.
- Bench (release, 20 alternating runs, load avg ~17–28). No difference beyond noise:

| query | main p50 / p99 | this PR p50 / p99 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| all-match, indexed: `UNWIND range(1,20000) AS x MERGE (n:Q {v:x}) RETURN count(*)` over 20k `:Q` nodes | 423.7 / 440.4 ms; swapped 416.1 / 440.4 ms | 420.2 / 431.7 ms; swapped 418.8 / 461.1 ms |
| all-create: `CREATE (t:T) WITH t UNWIND range(1,3000) AS x MERGE (t)-[:R]->(:X {v:x}) RETURN count(*)` | 10.24 / 17.45 ms; swapped 10.48 / 18.08 ms | 10.23 / 16.18 ms; swapped 10.45 / 17.52 ms |
